report.text: The target must move up to Close range directly away; if it cannot flee at all, it marks a Stress instead.

feature.name: Gravitic

mitigation.label: Echoing Plate

mitigation.label: Phasebound

feature.name: Anchored

You may then mark an additional Armor Slot to reflect the spell back towards the attacker by making a Spellcast roll against their difficulty.

actions.description: After mitigating all damage of the attack, mark an additional Armor Slot to reflect it against the attacker’s Difficulty.
